data.title: Roundup: Meta power case / AI weaponization / Post-9/11 flying
data.description: More transparency: Entergy Louisiana has agreed to expand access to highly confidential information in its power expansion case tied to Meta’s Richland Parish data center, allowing seven consumer advocates to review protected materials and their experts’ testimony. However, the groups still cannot access Meta records supporting projected jobs, investment and electricity demand. The case involves […]
